name: Tender Lovin' Cannibal
source:
TLC is a dating simulator wherein you, the player, try your hand at courting the barbaric butcher Bob Velseb. Can you win the heart of the creepy cannibal who's at large and in charge, or will you end up being the main course? Only time will tell!

[From: [url=https://rae1347.itch.io/tender-lovin-cannibal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
TLC是一款约会模拟器，在其中，玩家将尝试向野蛮屠夫鲍勃·维尔塞布 (Bob Velseb) 求爱。你能赢得逍遥法外、掌权的令人毛骨悚然的食人者的心，还是你最终会成为主菜？只有时间会证明一切！

[来自：[url=https://rae1347.itch.io/tender-lovin-cannibal]itch.io[/url]]
